meta.name: Sync and audit template vectors with Ollama embeddings and Qdrant

parameters.content:
## 🛠️ n8n Template Catalog Vector Sync

**Purpose:** Daily incremental ingestion and security auditing of public community workflow templates into Qdrant for local RAG retrieval.

**👤 Who It's For:**
Automation architects wanting a searchable, locally hosted vector database of ~749k n8n community workflow patterns.

**🔗 Quick Links & Seed Database:**
• **GitHub Repository**: [jdm6457/n8n-rag-suite](https://github.com/jdm6457/n8n-rag-suite)
• **Instant Seed Download**: `wget https://huggingface.co/datasets/jdm6457/n8n-rag-suite-snapshot/resolve/main/n8n_templates_749k.snapshot.gz`

**⚙️ Prerequisites:**
• Host Ollama running `nomic-embed-text:latest`
• Local Qdrant instance on port 6333 (`n8n_templates` collection)

**🚀 How to Use:**
1. Run manually once to fetch recent templates, or let the Schedule Trigger execute daily at 2:00 AM.
2. Alternatively, use the Hugging Face snapshot link above to seed the Qdrant database instantly without scraping.

### 1. Ingestion & Incremental Fetch
Fetches top community templates from n8n public catalog API.
* Pages 1–2 only (~200 items) for daily updates.
* Splits collection array into individual workflow items.

### 2. Full Extraction & Security Audit
* Pulls full workflow metadata, sticky note text, and system prompts.
* Strips non-printable ASCII/hex control characters.
* Scans node configuration strings for exposed API keys.

### 3. Purge Dupes, Embed & Vector Indexing
* Check for duplicate templates and delete them
* Embeds text content via Ollama (`nomic-embed-text`).
* Upserts vectors and metadata into Qdrant `n8n_templates` collection.
